salph_sum_decode, community_findings, phase0_primes + reference data.

commit.message:
GSMG: debunk fabricated 'SOLVED' issue #69 (XOR-token master key)

Master key 818af53d... reproduces from XOR of 7 token sha256 hashes but that's
circular (key defined as the XOR). It decrypts none of our valid blobs under
any IV/slice (printable 0.39, only block0 varies). Generalized direct-key XOR
method (638 token-sets x 3 blobs x 5 IVs) = zero valid decryptions. Issue gives
no private key + asks for reward/dusting = fabricated. Our transcription is the
structurally valid one (96B, ct%16=0).
